unitTargets: •  I can describe the Big Bang theory and the evidence that supports it.
•  I can explain how the first stars and heavier elements formed.
•  I can describe nebular theory and the steps that form a solar system.
•  I can describe the Sun's layers, activity cycle, and effects on Earth.
keyTerms: •  Singularity, nucleosynthesis, redshift, cosmic background radiation
•  Photosphere, chromosphere, corona, sunspot, prominence, solar wind, coronal mass ejection (CME)
howItWorks: The left column names what to record. Write it on the right while the slide is up. Cover the right side later and see how much you can bring back.
A teal rule down the left of a line means must-write. Copy those exactly.
Each section ends with a summary box. Close your notes before you write it.
